{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |location = [[Dragontail]] |location_page_description = Tasks the player with obtaining a {{Item|Heavy Pearl}} during the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. |x = -684.5 |y = 124 |z = -828.5 |location2 = [[Dragontail]] |location_page_description2 = Rewards the player with {{Reputation|Barbarian|150}} and {{Coins|200,000}} after handing in a {{Item|Heavy Pearl}}. |x2 = -686 |y2 = 116 |z2 = -832 }} '''Gris''' is an [[NPC]] located in one of the {{Zone|Dragontail}} houses. During the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], they task the player with obtaining a {{Item|Heavy Pearl}} from [[The Matriarch]]. == Quest == After giving a {{Item|Skeleton Fish}} and {{Item|Flyfish}} to {{NPCSprite|Lasea}} as part of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], the player is tasked with speaking to '''Gris''', who asks for them to collect a {{Item|Heavy Pearl}} from [[The Matriarch]]. After obtaining one, '''Gris''' can be then be found inside the house and down the ladder. Providing the {{Item|Heavy Pearl}} then rewards the player with {{Reputation|Barbarian|150}} and {{Coins|200,000}}. The player must then speak to {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} to continue the quest. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition !
